Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1265
Claimant:
Barbara Tran
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
24 Sep 2023
First notice of loss received for a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. The insured's vehilce was struck from
behind while stopped, and the claimant reports a concussion with headache and dizziness shortly after the impact.
8 Oct 2023
Confirmed with the insured that the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was active on the date of loss.
Assigned the file for property damage and bodily injury review.
13 Oct 2023
Contacted the other driver, who confirmed the sequence of events as first described. Police report on file lists the
claimant as a passenger in the struck vehicle.
15 Oct 2023
Reviewed the photographs taken at the scene. Rear damage to the vehicle is consitsent with the reported impact
speed and direction, and no prior damage was noted in the appraisal.
26 Oct 2023
Two independent witnesses gave recorded statements that match the other driver's account and the police narrative.
Nothing in their accounts conflicts with the physical evidence.
29 Nov 2023
Claimant is now represented by counsel, who has requested that all communication go through the firm. Diverted
further contact accordingly and noted the representation in the file.
28 Jan 2024
Received medical records covering the emergency visit and follow-up. The concussion diagnosis fits the mechanism
of the collision, and the records show no earlier treatment to the same area of the head or neck.
20 Mar 2024
Treatment followed a typical course, with symptoms easing over several weeks as the claimant improved and
follow-up visits were reduced accordingly.
1 Apr 2024
Claimant's counsel provided a supplemental statement adding minor details about seating position and the moment
of impact. The core account is unchanged from the original report.
1 May 2024
Reviewed the repair estimate against the damage pattern. The socpe of repairs matches the described impact, and
there is no indication the damage predates the policy's effective date.
2 May 2024
Reserves updated to reflect the medical course and repair scope. File remains open pending final bills from the
treating provider and counsel's demand package.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
